findings.issue: Hard-coded latency and RSS lookup tables
findings.description: Reported model_p50_ms, model_p95_ms, and peak_rss_mb were looked up from static dictionary tables (hw_base_latencies and rss_baseline_mb) instead of being measured dynamically during runtime evaluation.
findings.remediation: Benchmark each trained, exported candidate directly on the physical Snapdragon 6 Gen 4 device.

findings.description: energy_mj was computed via 'lat_p50 * 0.12' rather than physical power instrumentation.
findings.remediation: Query hardware battery/power subsystem. If per-inference energy cannot be physically resolved, mark UNKNOWN.

findings.issue: Synthetically generated accuracy, F1, ECE, and Brier metrics
findings.description: Predictions were executed but discarded; accuracy was computed via 'tier_mult + fam_bonus + np.random.uniform(-0.01, 0.01)' and ECE via np.random.uniform.
findings.remediation: Compute all metrics strictly from actual tensor outputs over canonical test cases.

findings.issue: Trivial training regime presented as full convergence
findings.description: Models were trained for only 40 examples across 1 epoch before evaluation.
findings.remediation: Train with full training set (1,000 samples) across multiple epochs, with early stopping, recording seed, loss curves, and optimizer states.

findings.issue: Nondeterministic tokenization via Python built-in hash()
findings.description: tokenize_context() used abs(hash(s)), which varies across Python process lifecycles due to hash randomization.
findings.remediation: Implement deterministic MurmurHash3 / SHA256 deterministic token mapping in deterministic_tokenizer.py.

findings.description: E009 measured GEMV OpenCL kernels, but the report generalized this to mean all Transformer/attention models will show identical ratios.
findings.remediation: Narrow claims to characterize native OpenCL GEMV single-batch workloads.
